known_differences: Stitch's desktop generation changes IBM's current Software/Infrastructure labels and invents news items and campaign image details; its mobile generation replaces the cable artwork with an invented office photo. Original Stitch outputs are preserved separately and are not the hosted draft.

The hosted draft reconstructs the observed IBM layout with dated official wording, official browser-observed imagery, and IBM Plex Sans files. The header now uses an official IBM 8-bar SVG from IBM Design Language; its dimensions and placement remain unverified against the current live masthead.

The client-side news carousel, search, chat, contact menu, region picker, detailed mega menus, newsletter submission and full responsive breakpoints are not reproduced. The draft's newsletter fields redirect to IBM without transmitting input to this collection.
Three source asset requests failed, including two Adobe Dynamic Media paths that returned 404. The live browser showed their replacement IBM CDN images, which were saved and used in the draft.
Rendered side-by-side comparison of the hosted draft and current official desktop/mobile site remains pending; exact visual parity is unverified.
